_key.description: Genomic element key, Ensembl gene ID, biosample term and cell annotation term joined by underscores.

method.description: Name of the experimental class or prediction model that produced this result.

label.description: Non-method specific human readable label for the node or edge
enum: predicted regulatory element effect on gene expression

class.description: The class of the data this record belongs to: 'observed data' for a direct experimental measurement, 'prediction' for the output of a computational model, and 'biological relationship' for a curated relationship.

score.description: scE2G score: Probability that the element has a regulatory effect on the target gene

transcription_start_site.description: Transcription start site of the target gene used by the model, as a 0-based coordinate.

rna_pseudobulk_tpm.description: RNA pseudobulk TPM of the target gene in the cell type

biological_context.description: Plain-language summary of the sample the assay was run in, taken from the associated files_filesets record.

biosample_term.description: Ontology term for the experimental sample, or the sample the prediction is valid for

cell_annotation.description: The cell annotation of the file set, with optional qualifier, for single-cell derived results.
cell_annotation.example: pluripotent epiblast cell derived from mouse embryonic stem cell

cell_annotation_term.description: Base ontology term describing the cell type of a single-cell derived result.

source.description: The database, dataset or organization that is a source for these data.

files_filesets.description: Reference to the File and Metadata

name.description: Directional human readable label for the relationship, _from to _to.

inverse_name.description: Reversed directional human readable label for the relationship, _to to _from.

accessible_via.return: class, label, method, source, source_url, files_filesets, biological_context, biosample_term, cell_annotation, cell_annotation_term, score, transcription_start_site, rna_pseudobulk_tpm
